jobs.title: Project Manager (Water/Wastewater Treatment)
jobs.description:
Job Description

The importance of water to the health of our world can’t be overstated.

As the frequency and intensity of floods, droughts and storms increases, the water industry must continue to build resiliency and lead from the front.

Together with our clients, we are thinking and doing things differently to help pre-empt and prepare for what's next. Be a part of this dynamic and committed team of diverse water specialists and drive change for your community.

You’ll be able to apply our powerful global network of skills and decades of experience to create positive water outcomes that respect nature and nurture communities.

Who are we looking for?

In response to continued growth within our US East Water & Wastewater Treatment business, our team in Bowie, MD
is seeking an experienced Project Manager
to help drive the development and expansion of our Water Business across the metro Washington, D.C. area. In this role, you’ll provide technical leadership and oversee the delivery of water and wastewater treatment and infrastructure projects for our valued clients. You’ll lead project teams, manage budgets and schedules, and serve as the project’s primary client contact; ensuring excellence in every phase of project execution.

Beyond project delivery, you’ll play an important role in business development, marketing strategies, and client engagement; with opportunities to shape win strategies and pricing for new work. This position also offers the chance to mentor project team members and collaborate with project team leaders across the region. If you’re passionate about innovative water solutions, thrive in a leadership role, and want to make an impact on critical infrastructure projects, we’d love to have you on our team!

Our Hybrid Work Model:

Be part of the dynamic culture! Our workplace thrives on a hybrid model, combining in-office collaboration and flexibility. Join us in the office three days a week to contribute, connect and excel in our vibrant environment.

Working with an energetic and high performing team, this position offers a variety of work and will see you involved in:

Client & Customer Management (External): Manage relationships with small clients while also helping senior colleagues manage relationships with larger key clients and customers.
Community of Practice Management: Participate actively in a community of practice in a defined area of expertise or consulting to build own expertise.
Contract Management: Deliver required outcomes by managing day-to-day relationships with contract service providers while working within an established contract management plan.
Engineering Solutions Design: Design engineering solutions and the associated validation process to enable the realization of a design brief (for example, in terms of functionality, performance, aesthetics, and cost) that conform to organizational and/or regulatory standards.
Feasibility Studies: Conduct complex feasibility studies from a technological and organizational perspective and document findings to complete cost-benefit analysis on implementing changes to business processes, products, or business unit structure.
Health, Safety, and Environment: Follow the organization's health, safety, and environment (HSE) policies, procedures, and mandatory instructions to identify and mitigate environmental risks and risks to the well-being of self and others in the workplace. Identify patterns of risky behavior within the team and take appropriate action to resolve them, escalating serious issues as appropriate.
Improvement/Innovation: Identify shortcomings in existing processes, systems, and procedures, and use established change management programs to address them.
Personal Capability Building: Develop own capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching; gain or maintain external professional accreditation, where relevant, to improve performance and fulfill personal potential. Maintain an in-depth understanding of technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.
Project Management: Deliver small- or medium-scale projects while working within an established program management plan.
Request for Bid Solicitation/Proposal/Tender Response: Gather information and resources, draft and complete proposals, and fulfill all process requirements (in terms of deadlines, documentation, etc.) in response to bid solicitations, request for proposal, and request for tender to create the best chance of being awarded the contract.
Technical Developments Recommendation: Discuss and recommend more complex or innovative technical developments to improve the quality of the used technology, such as systems, processes, infrastructure, installations, and machines.

What you’ll bring to the team:

Bachelor's and/or Master’s degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a related field of study with a water/wastewater focus
Professional Engineering license (Maryland or Virginia preferred)
Minimum of 10 years of experience in the planning, design and construction of water/wastewater infrastructure and treatment facilities (some time spent serving clients in the metro-Washington D.C. and surrounding area preferred)
Experience with business development, proposal preparation, and marketing skills preferred
A standout colleague and project leader with a strong client focus
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary technical staff
Practiced self-management skills related to organization, budget control, and schedule management

Benefits:

401K - Employees are eligible to participate on the first day of the month following 3 months of service
Paid time off – Our PTO benefit is designed to provide eligible employees with a period of rest and relaxation, sick, and personal time throughout the year. PTO starts at 16 days per year and increases with years of service
Holiday Pay - Holiday pay is provided for eligible employees. GHD observes 9 holidays per year. Holiday pay will be based on the regular set schedule for the employee
Wellness Benefit- Regular full-term employees are eligible to participate in the wellness reimbursement program. GHD will reimburse 50% of the cost of the following to maximum of $250.00 reimbursement annually for such items as: Health club membership fees, home exercise equipment purchases, Bicycles, Race, run & marathon entrance fees, Smoking cessation programs, Weight loss programs (i.e.—Weight Watchers, Jenny Craig), Fitbits and Fitness Tracking devices

Salary range:
$112,800-$188,000 based on experience and location

As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of a diverse workforce. GHD is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, genetic information, national origin, sex (including same sex), sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, age, disability or handicap, citizenship status, service member status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

About Us

Take on some of the world’s toughest challenges - with GHD supporting you every step of the way.

We'll give you control over your career, empower you to find innovative solutions and help you create a lasting impact.

See where your commitment could take you with GHD.

Our Pledge to You

At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day.

That’s why we pledge to empower our people to make a positive impact. Combining our deep technical expertise with the capabilities of our clients and partners, we respond to some of the most complex challenges facing our planet today.

See where your commitment could take you.

That’s the #PowerOfCommitment

Who We Are

GHD is a global professional services company that leads through engineering, architecture, and construction expertise. We are an employee-owned company with over 11,000 diverse and skilled individuals, across more than 200 offices spanning five continents.

The Power of Commitment is our brand promise. It’s what makes us different. We are bound to our stated vision and determination to address humanity’s most urgent needs: to make water, energy and urbanisation sustainable for generations to come.

Yes

Job Description:

The Acquisition Security Analyst
will assist the Government Program Manager with the development and implementation of comprehensive program protection methodologies to protect advanced technology programs throughout the system's life cycle.

Performance Shall Include:

In-depth lifecycle program analysis to identify critical program information (CPI), Critical System Resources (CSR), and their associated vulnerabilities
Assist with the identification and implementation of countermeasures
Develop and implement a risk managed based program protection plan and strategy
Provide technical advice and security support to collateral and SAP programs and emerging mission areas
Provide security guidance to the GSSO and PM, as it relates to the Air Force acquisition and sustainment process
Provide specific guidance pertaining to the contract security requirements in reference to cost, feasibility and appropriateness of requirement
Maintain a working relationship with the Program Manager, Contracting Officer and contractor security officers to ensure a standardized and correct format/process is utilized for all DD Form 254 efforts throughout the acquisition and sustainment lifecycle
Directly support customer program protection/security officers in the development, execution and implementation of Program Protection Planning (PPP)
Assess threat and risk, develop risk management actions and implements long term courses of actions
Assist in the development and writing of operations security (OPSEC) plans, transition plans, emergency action plans, transportation plans and any other security documents as needed for the customer
Review program documentation for public release, to include ensuring Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) has proper markings, classifications and distribution statements per Air Force doctrine
Conduct analysis of foreign intelligence threats against programs involving customer's critical research, sensitive technologies or CPI
Prepare and produce analytical products from numerous resources, to include various databases, to ensure a real-time, tailored product is provided
Provide classification guidance and assistance for all security programs to include collateral and SAP programs
Analyze Counterintelligence reports and prepare written summaries of activities with potential impact to customer resources
Write, review, and/or edit Security Classification Guides (SCG), Exposure Contingency Plans (ECP), Managed Access Plans (MAP), Security Operating Procedures (SOPs), System Test Plans (STP)
Assist government system security engineers performing close out actions for SAPs as needed
Develop and implement quarterly and annual security education and training for personnel
Provide technical analysis and OPSEC support to SAF/AAZ and SAF/AQ Special programs and other associated operations, missions, and organizational elements involved in developing system requirements to associated systems RDT&E

Experience
:

10+ years related experience
Minimum two (2) years of direct SAP experience

Education
:

Bachelor’s degree in a related area OR Associate’s degree in a related area + 2 years’ experience OR equivalent experience (4 years))

Education Experience Equivalents:

Security Fundamentals Professional Certification (SFPC) counts towards 3 years of experience
Special Program Security Certification (SPSC) counts towards 5 years of experience
Maximum equivalent experience for SPED Certifications is no more than 5 years

Security Clearance
:

TS/SCI, must be able to obtain TS/SCI with poly
Willingness to submit to a Counterintelligence polygraph

Other Requirements
:

Must have extensive knowledge of the DD Form 254 and how it is incorporated in the Air Force acquisition process

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:

401K with company match
Comprehensive health and wellness packages
Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career
Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications
Cutting-edge technology you can learn from
Rest and recharge with extra paid vacation and holidays

#AirforceSAPOpportunities

The likely salary range for this position is $158,610 - $214,590. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Travel Required:

None

Telecommuting Options:

Onsite

Work Location:

USA DC Washington

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards At GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development.

Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events at

Ability to read engineering drawings, P&IDs and technical specifications.

CSCS card.
Experience delivering chiller replacements, HVAC retrofits, plantroom upgrades or energy efficiency projects.
Familiarity with BMS and controls integration.
Knowledge of construction and engineering contracts.

Why Join Us?

Join a team delivering projects that support decarbonisation, energy efficiency and critical infrastructure across the UK. This is an opportunity to lead technically challenging projects, build strong customer relationships and make a real impact in a growing business.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst, Studios
jobs.description:
Who We Are

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Senior Business Analyst will establish and maintain a programme-level, source-traceable baseline by consolidating information from email, Teams and meeting records, Jira/Confluence, action and decision logs, design submissions, workshops and third-party inputs. The role will connect business needs to technical, property, operational and delivery workstreams, translate complexity into decision-ready outputs, and provide constructive challenge without replacing the responsibilities of technical SMEs, architects or delivery owners.

Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities

Lead discovery workshops and stakeholder discussions with TKO, IMG and relevant third parties.
Elicit, document, validate and prioritise business requirements across Broadcast and Corporate.
Map current- and future-state processes, user journeys, interfaces and operational hand-offs.
Consolidate inputs from networking, cloud, Corporate IT/AV, Broadcast IT and Security into a coherent programme view.
Identify gaps, overlaps, assumptions, dependencies, risks, ownership issues and unresolved decisions.
Maintain traceability from business needs through to technical requirements, design inputs, decisions and delivery actions.
Support the Broadcast interface with dB Broadcast and the Corporate interface.
Map dependencies and hand-offs across TKO, IMG, G&T, MiX, Perkins & Will, Hoare Lea and other project contributors.
Provide analysis to inform scope, RACI, RAID, action logs, decision logs, change control and operational readiness.
Produce concise updates highlighting progress, gaps, decisions required and next actions.
Maintain a single, programme-level and source-traceable baseline across workstreams, drawing together email, Teams and meeting records, Jira/Confluence, design documents, action logs, decision logs and third-party inputs.
Coordinate inputs and follow-up from the regular Project IT/AV/Security forum, including MiX and relevant TKO, IMG, property, engineering and specialist supplier representatives.
Translate technical and design outputs into clear business requirements, interface definitions, acceptance criteria, ownership questions, operational impacts and decision papers.
Support definition of operational ownership, monitoring responsibilities, escalation routes, support processes, service levels and handover evidence for building and technology services.
Support scope, budget, lead-time and delivery-impact analysis where technical, property or operational decisions affect programme sequencing and readiness.

Knowledge And Experience

Senior-level experience as a Business Analyst on complex transformation, infrastructure, new-build, relocation, workplace or property programmes.
Strong requirements elicitation, process mapping, user-journey, documentation and traceability skills.
Experience working across business, technology, programme and third-party delivery teams.
Ability to create structure where information, ownership and requirements are distributed across multiple teams.
Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
Experience working with technical SMEs across areas such as networking, cloud, AV, security or broadcast technology.
Understanding of live and non-live media workflows, or the ability to develop this quickly.
Experience supporting operational readiness, transition, service ownership or handover activity.
Comfortable working with ambiguity while maintaining clear, accurate and actionable outputs.
Familiarity with process modelling, requirements management and collaboration tools.
Ability to work across technical and non-technical domains and understand enough of network, cloud, security, broadcast, workplace and building-services interfaces to ask the right questions.
Ability to distinguish confirmed facts, working assumptions, decisions, risks, issues, dependencies and recommendations, and to challenge constructively when evidence or ownership is unclear.
Experience working within multi-party delivery and design-assurance models involving internal teams, consultants, integrators, suppliers and client-side stakeholders.
Strong analytical writing and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into concise outputs for senior stakeholders and delivery teams.

Approach

Applies a robust and systematic approach to discovery, analysis, documentation and validation.
Integrates effectively with the wider Project Programme Team.
Collaborates across TKO, IMG, Broadcast, Corporate and third-party workstreams.
Reports transparently on progress, risks, dependencies, gaps and decisions required.
Creates clarity without taking ownership of technical architecture or design decisions.
Balances sufficient detail for traceability with concise outputs that support decision-making.
Operates at programme level, connecting workstreams rather than optimising a single technical domain in isolation.
Uses evidence and validation: clearly records what is confirmed, what is assumed, what has been decided and what remains open.
Treats the baseline as a living source of truth, updating it as new information is received and preserving source and version traceability.
Brings ownership and decision gaps to the right people early, follows through on actions and escalates where unresolved issues threaten scope, cost, schedule or readiness.
Balances enough technical detail for traceability with clear business language, practical judgement and concise decision support.
Knowledge of cloud media workflows, content-production environments or enterprise technology integrations.
Familiarity with Corporate IT/AV, Broadcast IT, networking, security and building-services interfaces.
Experience working in both Agile and Waterfall programmes, including RACI, RAID and governance activity.
Experience on a complex new-build, relocation, campus consolidation or technology-enabled workplace programme.

Aptitudes

Ownership, accountability and delivery focus
Structured analysis, requirements and process expertise
Stakeholder engagement, facilitation, collaboration and influencing
Constructive challenge, problem-solving and pragmatic judgement
Programme integration and cross-domain thinking
Risk, dependency, issue and interface management
Ability to manage ambiguity and complexity
Clear, concise written and verbal communication

Success Measures

A consolidated, validated and traceable Project baseline is established.
Broadcast and Corporate requirements, processes, journeys and shared dependencies are clearly understood.
TKO’s distributed technical input is brought together into a coherent programme-level view.
Interfaces, hand-offs, ownership gaps, assumptions and unresolved decisions are visible and assigned or escalated.
Requirements can be traced through to scope, design, decisions, risks, actions and operational-readiness activity.
The Corporate interface into Project is sufficiently formalised to support planning and delivery.
The resulting baseline can be maintained by the Project team after the initial BA engagement.

In addition, success at IMG is driven by four core competencies
that apply to all employees:

Business Acumen
– Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes

Operational Excellence
– Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations

Innovation Mindset
– Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development

Leadership & Collaboration
– Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

Working Conditions

This is a 2 year fixed-term contract position
Working hours are 9:00 – 17:00, Monday to Friday
This will be based at the IMG Offices in Stockley Park, Uxbridge with travel to other IMG offices and/or buildings as required.
Adapting to use of new systems and technology where appropriate

TKO EEO Statement

TKO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding non-discrimination in employment. TKO makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications, without considering an employee’s or applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under federal, state or local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the Company has facilities. TKO also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state or local laws. For information about Privacy and Information Security for TKO employment candidates, please review our Privacy Policy. For information regarding Terms of Use for this and other TKO websites, please review our Terms of Use.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Manager - Response and Recovery
jobs.description:
Cyber Security Manager - DFIR (SC)

Lead the recovery when a client's worst day hits: rebuild, remediate and restore after ransomware and major cyber incidents, with one of the UK's Tier 1 incident response teams.

Location:
London (Canary Wharf) or Manchester, hybrid
Salary:
£75,000 – £85,000
Grade:
Manager, Cyber Advisory (Technology & Digital)
Clearance:
current SC or DV, or eligibility and willingness to obtain SC
Travel and on-call:
on-call rotation; short-notice travel for up to 2–3 weeks at a time

About the opportunity

Our client is one of only nine Tier 1 incident response providers in the UK, and its Cyber Response Services team is growing, with six new hires planned across grades. This Manager role focuses on what happens after an incident is contained: getting the business running again, safely, and making sure the attacker can't come back.

Clients turn to the team for ransomware, destructive malware, business email compromise, Active Directory compromise, cloud compromise and advanced network intrusions. You will turn incident findings into practical remediation, rebuild and recovery plans. You'll work alongside incident response leads, forensic teams, legal advisers, insurers and client executives. This is a hands-on recovery role, not a pure incident response one.

What you'll be doing

Leading recovery workstreams during major incidents and post-incident remediation programmes
Hands-on remediation across Active Directory, Windows and Linux, network, cloud, endpoint and security tooling, removing attacker persistence and restoring trust
Driving patching and vulnerability remediation, prioritised by business risk and threat actor behaviour
Reviewing and redesigning network architecture and security controls, including segmentation, firewall rules and administrative access paths, to reduce the risk of reinfection
Building isolated recovery environments and secure rebuild strategies, including backup validation and restore sequencing
Defining phased recovery and security improvement roadmaps, from immediate stabilisation to long-term transformation
Managing delivery end to end: stakeholder communication, reporting, proposals and mentoring junior team members

Between incidents, you'll support clients with recovery readiness and resilience work, such as recovery playbooks, Active Directory resilience assessments and ransomware recovery planning. You'll also help build the team's own capability: playbooks, tooling, automation, lab environments and training.

What you'll bring

Eligibility for SC clearance (existing SC or DV is beneficial)
Significant, proven cyber security incident experience, including supporting recovery from ransomware, Active Directory compromise, network intrusion or large-scale infrastructure incidents
Strong hands-on infrastructure skills across Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, networking and cloud (Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365), able to work at sysadmin level during recovery
Experience leading remediation: identity and AD hardening, patching, secure rebuild, backup validation and restoring business-critical services
A solid grasp of network architecture and security, including segmentation and firewall design
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to brief both technical teams and executives under pressure
Project and delivery management skills, including managing multiple workstreams and cases at once
Willingness to take part in the on-call rota and travel at short notice

Why join

Work on nationally significant incidents for a Tier 1 provider, with exposure across government and critical infrastructure
Shape a rapidly growing recovery capability rather than join a settled one
Investment in certifications, training and technical growth
A clear route into senior cyber response and recovery leadership

Location and working pattern

Hybrid, with about 60% of the week with clients or in the office and 40% elsewhere, including home. You must live within commuting distance of Canary Wharf, London or St Peter's Square, Manchester.

Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We spun out of Peppy Health to take on what we believe is the biggest untouched opportunity in enterprise software.

for global benefits teams. It uses LLMs to parse and extract policy documents into a structured ontology, and gives admins spend and utilisation tools across every country they operate in.
Navigator
, the employee-facing product that helps people understand and use their benefits.

Deployment Strategist
you will spend roughly 80% of your time on client work and 20% on developing our products. You will own a portfolio of approximately 1 to 3 enterprise accounts, depending on size, from post-sale through live launch and beyond.

jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

In the role of Program Manager, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary infrastructure programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of infrastructure programs, which are all critical to program success. Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client's specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution. This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, construction management, cost control/estimating, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making. Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff. Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communications. Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance. Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program's financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR's program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Professional Engineering License
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
PMI Program Management Professions (PgMP) certification
CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one [transportation/water/resources] infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff
Willingness to travel and, if needed, commute to a client's site temporarily

Keywords: Water, Wastewater, Project Manager, Program Manager, Construction Manager, Pump Station, Pipeline, Treatment, Stormwater, Environmental, Utilities, Design,

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Planning, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Program management experience consistent with one of the following requirements:
A minimum of three (3) years of program management experience in a deputy role to the Program Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, with a cumulative capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of five (5) years of program management experience as a Project Manager or Project Controls Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, each with a capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of ten (10) years of project management experience as a Project Manager directing a multi-disciplinary team for the delivery of at least two (2) projects, each with a capital value of $50 million or more
Strong leadership skills with experience building a cohesive team culture and managing team members in various locations.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to client executives and in front of a large audience in a public setting
Management experience with the implementation of projects or programs using alternative and collaborative delivery methods, including design-build (DB), progressive design-build (PDB), and/or construction management at-risk (CMAR)

jobs.title: Project Manager, Value Improvement Office
jobs.description:
MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

The Value Improvement Office (VIO) Project Management Office (PMO) division is responsible for a range of activities related to the design, planning, execution, facilitation, implementation, and completion of non-information technology operational projects adhering to timeline, budget, and scope. They oversee all aspects of MemorialCare VOI PMO projects and are responsible for working closely with the project stakeholders, including vendor management. Throughout the course of projects, they assign responsibilities, monitor and report on progress of projects, as well as prepare reports for leadership regarding the status of the project.

The Project Manager provides consulting, scoping analysis, and overall project management related to the organization’s operational initiatives. The role is responsible for utilizing the end-to-end project management process from executive approval through governance, planning, implementation to warm hand off to operations, and post-go-live review. This position works independently with executive leaders, multi-disciplinary teams across the healthcare system, and external stakeholders to manage and successfully implement each project and acts as the point of accountability for delivering large scale, complex, and cross-functional implementations on time and on budget.

Manages all phases of assigned projects including initiation, definition and planning, execution, monitoring and cost control, and project close out. Works to identify and define project requirements, scope, and objectives
Assists all stakeholders in making sure overall project needs and objectives are understood and executed as projects evolve through the development cycle. Where necessary, applies assertiveness to ensure that the project moves along and that decisions are made in a timely manner.
Develops project strategies, defines project schedules, manages resources and equipment, develops plans and reports, and tracks information.
Evaluate project performance and setting quality and performance standards
Identifies and resolves problems of varying complexity that arise in and outside of the department
Conducts root cause analysis of problems and take actions to prevent recurring instances of issues
Develop and maintain project budgets and oversee expenditures/procurement
Coordinates and manages project governance requests throughout their lifecycle and ensures proper documentation and communication to all stakeholders.
Facilitates project meetings; documents and follows-up on actions and decisions. Records and distributes meeting minutes within a timely manner.
Ensures that both client and VIO teams’ needs are met as projects evolve, monitors project progress, handles issues that arise, and communicates regularly on project developments to relevant participants in efforts to maintain overall visibility.
Ensures proper communication on assigned tasks, both internally to the Team and externally to stakeholders. Responsible for aligning expectations to clearly define requirements and deliver expected results for assigned project tasks.
Creates and maintains documentation, plans, templates, and reports on assigned tasks.
Helps prepare project proposals, timeframes, and schedule, breaking projects out into measurable milestones.
Monitors and reports on progress against established project milestones related to working hours, plans, and expenditures, utilizing MemorialCare provided tools. Analyzes risks, as well as opportunities and areas for improvement and reports project outcomes and/or escalates risks to appropriate individuals
Placement in the pay range is based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant years of experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, there may be additional compensation available for this role, including but not limited to, shift differentials, extra shift incentives, and bonus opportunities. Health and wellness is our passion at MemorialCare—that includes taking good care of employees and their dependents. We offer high quality health insurance plan options, so you can select the best choice for your family. And there’s more...Check out our MemorialCare Benefits for more information about our Benefits and Rewards.
Minimum 3 years project management or relevant experience required
Demonstrated understanding of key areas of the healthcare business
Understanding and application of Lean, process improvement discipline
Demonstrated high energy levels and tolerance of tight deadlines, time pressures, and ambiguity
Past success leading project with multiple business stakeholders, technical resources, and third parties for solutions
Proven knowledge of PCs, collaborative computing tools, re-engineering and process improvement techniques, information management in healthcare, systems integration, and basic project finance regulations
Experienced in leading projects, providing expert consultative guidance and direction on change initiatives, effectively dedicating time across more than one project, and meeting established deadlines
Proven ability to prepare and interpret flowcharts, schedules, and step-by-step action plans
Demonstrated proficiency with the Microsoft Suite Products required
Demonstrated analytical, creative thinking, and problem-solving skills
Proven superior oral and written communication and presentation skills; able to interact with individuals across all departments
Experienced exercising good judgment in fast-paced, high-pressure work environment, with competing priorities
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare experience required
Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent PMI recognized certification preferred
Lean Certification preferred

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Associate Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position:
Behavioral Health Associate Program Manager

Type:
Salary, Full-Time, Exempt

Compensation:
Up to $81,000 per year (base salary + performance bonus)

Benefits

Health Insurance (Medical, Vision, Dental, Life)
PTO (Sick, Vacation)
Equity Shares
Company Car

Key Responsibilities

Second-in-command to the Program Director, providing leadership and operational support across the program, with primary responsibility for evening and weekend coverage.

Training & Accountability: The Associate Manager ensures that all program staff are carrying out their daily functions and responsibilities through continuous monitoring, training, and accountability, supporting the Program Director in maintaining consistent performance standards.
Staffing & Scheduling: The Associate Manager is responsible for ensuring that the program operates within its Staffing Guidelines and maintains adequate coverage on every shift, at all times (including timekeeping), with a particular focus on evening and weekend operations.
Compliance: The Associate Manager ensures strict adherence to Akua's policies, regulatory standards, and licensing requirements, helping keep the program fully licensed, credentialed, accredited, and in good standing.
Employee Management: The Associate Manager actively participates in hiring, interviewing candidates within staffing guidelines, and oversees disciplinary actions and terminations (in coordination with the Program Director), ensuring compliance with HR policies.
Emergency Management: The Associate Manager is responsible for promptly communicating and resolving any client issues/crisis (including participating in the on-call rotation) and acts as the primary point of contact when the Program Director is unavailable.
Performance and Cost Management: The Associate Manager monitors key program metrics to drive performance improvements and ensures cost control by adhering to budgetary guidelines, including staffing, scheduling, and operational expenses, in support of the Program Director's goals.
Weekend & Evening Coverage: The Associate Manager provides primary coverage during the evening shift (4:00 pm - 12:30 am) and on weekends, with two rest days scheduled during the weekdays. This role ensures continuous leadership presence and operational continuity outside of standard daytime hours.

Requirements

License/Credentials: RADT/CADC/SUDCC, or functional equivalent (preferred)
Education: Bachelor's Degree (required) or master's degree (preferred) in a relevant field (e.g. Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Psychology)
Experience: 2+ years of behavioral health experience and 1+ year(s) of lead experience (required)
Additional: Valid CA Driver's License, Current Health Screen / Physical, TB Test Clearance, Current CPR/First Aid certificate, Able to Pass Live Scan (required)

Company Description

Akua Behavioral Health is California's leading mental health and substance abuse treatment center. We provide our clients with individualized, compassionate treatment from Master's and Doctorate level clinicians across various levels of care at fully licensed and accredited facilities throughout Northern and Southern California. To give our clients the best chance at lasting recovery, we pioneered an integrative East-meets-West approach that combines Western evidence-based treatment with holistic Eastern traditions to treat the mind, body, and spirit. Our mission is to provide the highest quality of behavioral healthcare for every client by ensuring our team is 100% trained and motivated to deliver industry leading client outcomes.

Easterseals Southern California transforms lives every day. For over a century, Easterseals has championed inclusion and independence—delivering essential services like early childhood programs, autism services, employment and independent living support to more than 29,000 people each year. Through advocacy and education, we break barriers and create opportunities for the one-in-four Americans with disabilities.

Under moderate supervision, provides project management oversight and direction to ensure overall success of an assigned number of initiatives by developing appropriate project implementation plans to include but not limited to scope, goals, scheduling and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with management. Plans, schedules and tracks project timelines, milestones and deliverables using appropriate tools. Estimates resources and participants needed to achieve project goals and determines the need. Ensures projects/department milestones/goals are met and adhering to approved budgets. Assures compliance of projects and solutions with applicable standards and regulations, internal and external to the organization. In all responsibilities, the position demonstrates a strong commitment to ESSC’s mission and values by supporting a high-quality, person-centered service environment.

Starting Salary Range: $87k - $110k / yr.

Overview Of Position

Under moderate supervision, provides project management oversight and direction to ensure overall success of an assigned number of initiatives by developing appropriate project implementation plans to include but not limited to scope, goals, scheduling and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with management. Plans, schedules and tracks project timelines, milestones and deliverables using appropriate tools. Estimates resources and participants needed to achieve project goals and determines the need. Ensures projects/department milestones/goals are met and adhering to approved budgets. Assures compliance of projects and solutions with applicable standards and regulations, internal and external to the organization. In all responsibilities, the position demonstrates a strong commitment to ESSC’s mission and values by supporting a high-quality, person-centered service environment.

Essential Functions

Coordinates projects activities related to project definition, planning, and execution of projects while utilizing ESS standard project management processes.
Plans, prioritizes, monitors, provides direction, and validates work of project team to ensure appropriate skills, workload, quality and timeliness of deliverables.
Provides periodic reporting of status of projects, costs, schedules, contractual deliverables, among other key metrics to PMO leadership team, project governance team and executive leadership team as applicable. Effective escalation of project risks and issues along with relevant mitigation strategies to support quality and timely delivery of projects.
Makes decisions in end-to-end project management, demonstrating ownership of the entire process from beginning to end while developing and implementing program and project level processes, procedures and performance metrics.
Develops and provides training on project management office frameworks and best practices; creates and standardizes tools; and aligns practices with industry standards and evidence-based practices.
Showcases on-time delivery with flawless project launches from project kickoff to production release or go-live.
Maintains project budgets, and supports earned value management, ROI analysis and KPI tracking.
Acts as the single point of contact for internal and external team members on project status, execution, and escalation.
Schedules, facilitates and supports meetings with appropriate meeting material and notes.
Actively solicits internal and customer feedback to improve business relationships.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Health Management, Psychology, or other relevant field.
Master’s degree in a related field is preferred.
Project Management certification is required (PMP, CSM).

Experience

4-6 years of Project Management experience required. Hands-on experience leading, managing and delivering projects centered around process improvements, healthcare technology, and clinical operation preferred.
Strong understanding of various projects management methodologies and tools.
Process improvement experience and certification like LEAN Six Sigma, Six Sigma Black/Green Belt is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

EXEPECTED NUMBER OF DIRECT REPORTS:

Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, take initiative, prioritize; excellent time management, creative thinking, decision-making, analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Ability to motivate project resources without direct reporting relationship effectively to deliver projects.
Ability to understand business requirements/concepts and facilitate discussions in project context.
Ability to identify and seek needed information/research and analytical skills. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions.
Ability to effectively manage and lead multiple fast-paced technical and non-technical projects of medium to large size, and medium to high complexity, and provide high quality results.
Experience developing and delivering technical and non-technical presentations for team, corporate, and service line leadership. Ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Thorough knowledge of local, state, federal, and applicable regulations regarding clinical systems, PHI and HIPAA or the ability to acquire this knowledge.
Ability to acquire an understanding of organization and department policies, procedures, and practices.
Ability to adapt to a dynamic environment and learn department-specific technology and computer systems.|
Proficiency with MS Office applications (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, Outlook), Smartsheets, JIRA , other project management tools and familiar with clinical systems.
Ability to communicate effectively, through oral and written skills, with all levels of staff and the general public; and maintain customer service orientation and professionalism in all interactions.
Ability to exercise discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality with sensitive and confidential situations and documentation.
Ability to obtain and maintain a criminal record/fingerprint clearance from the Department of Justice and Federal Bureau of Investigation, per Easterseals Southern California and/or program requirements.
Ability to work after hours and weekends as needed.
Must pass all drug testing required by ESSC and a post-offer physical evaluation.

Carrying/Lifting: Occasional / 0-10 lbs.
Standing: Occasional / Up to 3 hours per day.
Sitting: Constant / Up to 8 hours per day.
Walking: Occasional / Up to 3 hours per day.
Travel: Occasional, as work requires.
Repetitive Motion/Activity: Keyboard activity, telephone use, writing.
Visual Acuity: Ability to view computer monitor and read newsprint.
Environmental Exposure: None.

jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

In the role of Program Manager, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary infrastructure programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of infrastructure programs, which are all critical to program success. Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client's specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution. This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, construction management, cost control/estimating, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.

Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff. Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communications. Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance. Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program's financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.

AICP Certification

Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff

jobs.description:
The Challenge:

•           Manage mechanical engineering activities for EPS and Column EPS projects, working directly with automotive customers.

•           Act as the technical liaison between customers, sales, manufacturing plants and engineering teams

in Europe and Japan.

•           Analyse and clarify customer technical specifications and requirements.

•           Coordinate mechanical and system-related technical issues throughout the project lifecycle.

•           Support system engineering development activities related to mechanical systems.

•           Define, coordinate and follow up validation and testing activities.

•           Support European manufacturing plants on mechanical engineering topics and technical concerns.

•           Contribute to localization and industrialization projects.

•           Ensure project activities remain aligned with timing, quality and customer expectations.

•           Coordinate activities according to NSK development processes, automotive standards and customer

quality requirements.

•           Prepare project status updates and contribute to regular Steering Committee reporting.

•           Maintain strong, professional and trusted relationships with customers and NSK engineering teams         worldwide.

•           Contribute to continuous improvement activities within the European Technology Center.

•           Perform all activities in accordance with NSK Quality, Health & Safety and Environmental     requirements.

Your Profile:

•           Engineering degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or equivalent.

•           Experience

•           Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in automotive engineering, preferably involving mechatronic or

electromechanical systems.

•           Experience with automotive product development from concept phase through to mass production.

•           Experience working within an international engineering organization is highly desirable.

Technical Skills

Your Experience:

•           Electric Power Steering or automotive mechatronic systems

La mission s'inscrit dans un chantier réglementaire majeur portant sur la mise en conformité des systèmes de calcul des risques avec les exigences CRR3-CRD6. Le périmètre couvre les risques centraux de la banque, notamment le risque de crédit, le CVA et les approches standardisées et internes (STD, IRB, SACCR). Les travaux concernent à la fois la refonte des moteurs de calcul et la production du reporting réglementaire associé.

Le besoin

La mission requiert un Business Analyst IT junior capable d'intervenir en MOA sur la phase 2 de mise en œuvre de la réglementation Bâle IV. Le consultant prendra en charge la définition et l'exécution des recettes fonctionnelles sur les moteurs bâlois, ainsi que la rédaction de la documentation projet (user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles, plans de tests). Une connaissance de la réglementation Basel III/IV, des risques de crédit, du CVA et du reporting réglementaire est requise pour ce poste.

Vos missions

Définition et rédaction des cas de tests et de la stratégie de recette fonctionnelle pour les moteurs bâlois
Exécution des recettes fonctionnelles et analyse des anomalies détectées
Rédaction de la documentation projet : user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles, plans de tests
Assistance fonctionnelle aux développements et aux tests unitaires
Production du reporting projet et préparation des supports de présentation pour les comités

L'environnement

Domaines : risque de crédit, CVA, SACCR, IRB, reporting réglementaire (COREP, FINREP), gestion des fonds propres (RWA)

Réglementaire : Basel III / Bâle IV, CRR3, CRD6

Outils & données : Mainframe, SQL

Le consultant

Formation Bac+5 — Master 2 ou école d'ingénieur, idéalement avec une spécialisation en finance. Une première expérience en MOA dans un environnement bancaire est attendue, avec une connaissance avérée de la réglementation Basel III/IV, du risque de crédit, du CVA et du reporting réglementaire. Ces compétences sont indispensables : un candidat qui ne les maîtrise pas ne pourra pas répondre aux exigences de la mission. jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe electricity powers modern life. As part of our Power sector, you’ll help shape how electricity is generated, transmitted and delivered as global energy demands grow. From massive data centers to modernizing transmission systems, our industry-recognized engineers and scientists have been at the forefront of grid transformation for more than a century. You’ll work side-by-side with these experts and contribute to reliable, resilient and sustainable power systems, helping communities thrive and industries expand. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to drive infrastructure forward, power innovation and leave your mark on our energy future.

HDR is seeking a Power Program Manager
to join our rapid-growth team to lead the planning and execution of programs and projects for our power clients. The successful candidate for this position will be a well-rounded, team-oriented individual with excellent communication skills who can deliver and execute infrastructure projects.

In this role, the Program Manager will lead a diverse, multidisciplinary team of technical and non-technical professionals to deliver power infrastructure projects. The Program Manager will also serve as a trusted advisor to the client’s leadership team, providing guidance on delivery strategies, processes, and tools, and recommending effective approaches to program governance and team management. Success in this role requires a strong focus on the client’s best interests and a commitment to HDR’s purpose: we do things right to make great things possible.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead multidisciplinary teams to deliver T&D, power generation, renewable energy, etc. projects to achieve strategic outcomes defined by clients.
Serve as primary point of contact for clients regarding scope, contract management, program performance, work planning, staffing, etc.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, strategic planning, delivery strategies, financial aspects of power programs.
Direct and manage the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR staff and subconsultants including engineering, project controls, routing and siting, environmental, real estate, strategic communication, data management etc. team based on the size, complexity, and phase of programs.
Assess staffing needs of programs and secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance. Promote team alignment on program mission and monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Facilitate risk workshops with clients and other subcontractors. Work with internal risk professionals to provide qualitative and/or quantitative risk management plans to clients.
Develop and implement program management plans, business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Work closely with project controls team to monitor scope, schedule and budget performance of the program against pre-established metrics and adjust as necessary to meet budget and control losses.
Prepare monthly program report or update dashboard to communicate internally to program team and externally to clients or other stakeholders the health and progress of program.
Collaborate with an internal business development team to identify clients with growth prospects.
Champion program management pursuits and support development of proposals including project approach, staffing plan, fees and schedule.
Travel on average 25% of the time expected.

Preferred/Desired Qualifications

Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration or closely related field.
Professional Engineers License and/or PMP Certification.
Experience implementing PMIS (Project Management Information System) such as E-Builder, ProCore, Kahua, Oracle Primavera, etc.

,

Program management experience consistent with one of the following requirements:
A minimum of three (3) years of program management experience in a deputy role to the Program Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, with a cumulative capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of five (5) years of program management experience as a Project Manager or Project Controls Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, each with a capital value of $200 million or more, or;

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

jobs.description:
Job Req ID: 30105

About Supermicro

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

Job Summary

Super Micro Computer, Inc. is seeking a PCB Project Manager to join our U.S. team. This role owns the monitoring and coordination of PCB New Product Introduction (NPI) and Mass Production (MP) projects, ensuring clear communication between internal Operations and Asia-based teams, and driving timely follow-through so that project requirements are properly supported. The ideal candidate takes ownership of project visibility, issue tracking, and cross-regional alignment while working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor the progress of PCB New Product Introduction (NPI) and Mass Production (MP) projects, tracking key milestones, schedules, and deliverables to ensure alignment with project timelines.
Maintain accurate project status trackers, schedules, and action logs; proactively identify risks, delays, or gaps and drive appropriate follow-up or escalation.
Partner with the internal Operations team to clarify requirements and ensure they are clearly documented and communicated to supporting teams.
Serve as the primary point of contact with Asia-based teams for project requirements; own the communication loop to confirm understanding and drive timely support and responses.
Facilitate effective cross-regional collaboration, ensuring information flows accurately between U.S. relevant stakeholders and Asia-based team and that open items are actively managed to closure.
Prepare and present clear, concise status updates, progress reports, and issue summaries to stakeholders; take ownership of keeping leadership informed of project health.
Drive resolution of coordination issues and support gaps by following up with responsible parties, tracking actions, and escalating when necessary.
Provide feedback on process or communication gaps observed during project execution and support continuous improvement efforts.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
2-4 years experience in project management or procurement within the electronics, PCB design, PCB fabrication, or PCBA manufacturing industry.
Basic understanding of PCB development lifecycle, including basic knowledge of design, fabrication processes, assembly (SMT/PCBA), and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
Strong ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities with keen attention to detail.
Demonstrated experience in vendor negotiations, particularly with suppliers in Asia. Mandarin speaking is a plus.
Excellent communication and organizational skills, with a problem-solving mindset.
Proficiency in ERP applications and Microsoft Office tools such as SAP, Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
Hands-on knowledge of high-speed digital, RF, mixed-signal, or high-layer-count PCB design considerations, Signal Integrity (SI)/Power Integrity (PI), and related trade-offs is a plus.

We value diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you meet most of the required qualifications and are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply.

Salary Range

$95,000 - $110,000

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. The Content & Business Products (CBP) teams are fundamental to Netflix's mission to entertain the world. This organization is responsible for building the products and services that optimize and automate the entire content creation lifecycle, from initial concept and financial planning to global launch and promotion.

CBP is the engine behind "pitch to play," enabling our teams to create, manage, and distribute content at scale. In addition, we build and maintain critical enterprise products that ensure efficient operations across key internal departments, including Finance, Talent, and Customer Support.

The Team -Enterprise Engineering

Our guiding principle is to champion a "Connected Enterprise"—where integrated data and workflows replace isolated point solutions.

We are seeking a dynamic Technical Program Manager with high agency and a strong sense of ownership to lead high-impact, cross-functional programs. Lead multiple cross-functional programs, in collaboration with product, engineering, design, and data science, that deliver technical solutions.
Drive engagement with cross-functional partners, work to decompose requirements into technical execution plans with measurable milestones, effectively optimize scope and schedule, manage cross-functional dependencies, and proactively identify and manage risks.
Craft clear, concise communication regarding progress toward goals, reporting status and insights to stakeholders and executive leadership.
Provide domain expertise to form technical strategies with engineering partners.
Scope and lead the execution of Generative AI/ML initiatives, working with engineering and data science partners to identify high-value use cases and productionize new AI platform capabilities.
Apply strong technical, organizational, and communication skills to devise sound technical approaches to abstract goals.
Identify the systems involved to build new solutions, align roadmaps, and weigh relative priorities.
Build strong relationships and rally the team with high emotional intelligence and exceptional listening skills.
Operate independently, challenge the status quo, and always play for the larger team.

Highly skilled, experienced, and enjoys orchestrating multiple programs with many moving parts and creating partnerships with cross-functional teams

Deep understanding and point of view on the application of agentic capabilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate business impact and technical constraints tailored to the audience
As comfortable speaking technically as non-technically and able to bridge between the two.
Detail-oriented, can identify what’s missing in planning and execution of software development, testing, and launch.
Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

La rete di aziende Eurofins è leader a livello globale nell’analisi di alimenti, ambiente, prodotti farmaceutici e cosmetici, nonché nella farmacologia della scoperta, nella medicina legale, nelle scienze avanzate dei materiali e nei servizi di ricerca in ambito agro-scientifico.
