new_jobs.title: Senior Cyber Security Manager - Response & Recovery
new_jobs.description:
Senior Operations Manager – Cyber Response and Recovery

Security Clearance:
Current Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV) clearance required, or eligibility and willingness to obtain the appropriate clearance.

Location:
London (Canary Wharf) or Manchester (St Peters Square)
Flexibility:
Hybrid, 2-3 days on-site per week
Salary:
Up to £110,000
Travel and on-call:
On-call rotation; short-notice travel for up to 2–3 weeks at a time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Operations Manager to join our growing Cyber Response and Recovery practice. This is an exciting opportunity to take on a key operational leadership role within a high-performing cyber security team supporting a diverse portfolio of clients.

Reporting directly to the Cyber Response Capability Lead, you will work closely with senior leadership to support the continued growth and development of the organisation's cyber response services, encompassing both reactive incident response and proactive capability development.
Our clients face an increasingly complex cyber threat landscape and rely on our expertise to help them understand, manage and respond to cyber security incidents.

This is a hands-on operational management position, offering exposure to a wide range of clients and complex cyber incidents, including nationally significant events. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong operational and project management capabilities, leading the coordination and deployment of incident response case managers and technical practitioners.

Alongside incident response operations, you will support clients in developing their internal cyber incident response capabilities.

This may include:
Developing and enhancing cyber response tools.
Creating and adapting incident response runbooks and playbooks.
Assessing incident response maturity.
Supporting cyber incident tabletop exercises and scenario testing.

When not engaged in client delivery, you will contribute to business development and the ongoing development of internal delivery capabilities, including operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, team development, tooling, platforms and laboratory environments.

Why Join

Work within a recognised leading cyber incident response capability.
Gain exposure to nationally significant cyber incidents.
Work across a diverse range of sectors, including government, defence, critical national infrastructure, corporate organisations and financial services.
Access investment in professional certifications and technical training.
Play a key role in shaping and developing a rapidly growing cyber response capability.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and coordinate day-to-day cyber response team operations, maintaining oversight of active cases and ensuring priority and mandatory activities are completed.
Work closely with the Capability Lead to provide regular operational updates and reporting.
Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, policies and ways of working, including standardised documentation and delivery artefacts.
Monitor team revenue, project financials and billing, ensuring accurate and effective financial management.
Project manage the development of internal cyber response tools, identifying opportunities for improvement and coordinating new initiatives, workstreams, resources and delivery timelines.
Support the management and development of the cyber response team, monitoring utilisation and advising on resource and capacity requirements.
Act as a point of contact between clients and the cyber response team where required, providing updates and coordinating engagement with wider international cyber response capabilities.
Support business development activities, including preparing high-quality responses to bids and requests for proposals.
Identify and take ownership of additional responsibilities to support the effective day-to-day running and continued development of the team.

The Person

You may have started your career in cyber incident response, although this is not essential. Equally, your technical knowledge may have been developed through self-directed learning or experience in an adjacent discipline.

What matters most is a proactive, solutions-focused attitude and the ability to operate confidently in ambiguous and challenging situations.

You will be comfortable working collaboratively, consulting with internal stakeholders and clients, and developing solutions where all the answers are not immediately available.

You will be someone who is willing to roll up their sleeves, learn, share knowledge and take ownership to ensure objectives are achieved, even when activities fall outside your immediate responsibilities.

You will also demonstrate experience in:

Tackling complex client challenges and delivering high-quality solutions at scale and pace.
Quickly understanding complex concepts and translating them into clear, concise and practical information for clients.
Building credibility with senior stakeholders and adapting your communication style to different audiences.
Developing structured plans and taking ownership of delivering outcomes, even when faced with uncertainty.
Exercising sound judgement, maintaining a considered approach and recognising when additional support or expertise is required.

In addition, you will:

Be a motivated self-starter, capable of working with minimal direction.
Demonstrate strong leadership capabilities and experience managing teams.
Be comfortable operating in unfamiliar situations and able to absorb and process information quickly, particularly technical information.
Maintain high standards of service delivery and quality across internal and external engagements.
Apply strong project management skills, including decision-making, analytical thinking, time management, prioritisation and organisation.
Demonstrate initiative, resilience and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a pressurised environment.
Communicate effectively with senior management, international colleagues and geographically distributed teams.
Be comfortable working in a diverse and international environment.
Have excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
Show a genuine interest in developing, mentoring and supporting junior team members.
Maintain exceptional attention to detail while overseeing multiple concurrent activities and cases.

Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate will have previous experience in an operational management, business operations or Chief of Staff-type role, ideally involving the management of technically specialised teams.

The following skills and experience are desirable:

The ability to communicate effectively with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders at all levels of seniority.
Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality client deliverables supported by robust analysis, insight and research.
Experience of budgeting, financial management and resource allocation.
Strong IT literacy, particularly Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
A recognised project management qualification, although this is not essential.
A mature, self-sufficient and proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to deliver high-quality work to tight deadlines.
Previous experience or knowledge of cyber security, which would be advantageous but is not essential.

Location and Working Arrangements

The role is based around one of two principal office locations:
London – Canary Wharf.
Manchester – St Peter's Square.

Candidates must live within reasonable commuting distance of one of these locations.
The current working arrangement involves spending approximately 60% of the working week with clients or in the office, with the remaining 40% offering flexibility to work elsewhere, including from home.

Occasional short-notice travel may be required.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Vær med til at styrke sikkerheden i kritisk infrastruktur
new_jobs.description:
Lokation: Aarhus, Aalborg eller København

Motiveres du af at drive komplekse projekter inden for fysisk sikkerhed og kritisk infrastruktur? Har du erfaring med projektledelse og lyst til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem sikkerhed, myndighedskrav og forretningskritiske anlæg? Så er du måske vores nye Project Manager.

Bliv en del af et team med fokus på sikkerhed og infrastruktur

Du bliver en del af Physical Security i Facility, hvor vi arbejder med at beskytte kritisk infrastruktur på tværs af Norlys’ lokationer. Trusselsbilledet har ændret sig markant de senere år, og derfor er fysisk sikkerhed blevet et område med øget fokus, høj prioritet og stigende kompleksitet.

Teamet består af tre specialister og en leder. Vi er et lille, fagligt stærkt team med en uformel omgangstone, høj grad af tillid og et stærkt fællesskab. Vi løfter i flok, passer på hinanden og tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, humor og gensidig respekt.

Som Project Manager bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at udvikle og implementere sikkerhedsløsninger på tværs af Norlys' mange lokationer og kritiske sites. Rollen indebærer løbende besøg på vores lokationer rundt om i landet, og du skal derfor forvente en vis rejseaktivitet.

Skab overblik og fremdrift i komplekse sikkerhedsprojekter

Som Project Manager får du ansvaret for at skabe sammenhæng, struktur og fremdrift på tværs af en portefølje af sikkerhedsprojekter. Du bliver den samlende kraft mellem specialister, leverandører og interne interessenter og sik-rer, at projekterne gennemføres effektivt og i overensstemmelse med gældende krav.

Primære opgaver og ansvarsområder:

Drive og koordinere projekter inden for fysisk sikkerhed på tværs af Norlys' lokationer
Sikre overblik over projektporteføljen og understøtte prioritering af indsatser og investeringer
Bidrage til risikovurderinger og beslutningsgrundlag for projekter og sikkerhedsforanstaltninger
Sikre, at projekter efterlever gældende myndighedskrav og relevante sikkerhedsstandarder, herunder NIS2
Koordinere samarbejdet med interne interessenter inden for blandt andet Risk, Compliance, Procurement og Facility Management
Sikre fremdrift og opfølgning på leverancer fra eksterne samarbejdspartnere og leverandører
Understøtte budgettering, planlægning og rapportering på tværs af projekterne
Bidrage til den løbende udvikling og styrkelse af Norlys' fysiske sikkerhedsniveau.

I rollen er du primært ansvarlig for projektledelse og koordinering samt for at sikre, at kvalitetssikring, dokumentation og øvrige leverancer er på plads, inden projekterne afsluttes. Implementering og installation af løsninger gennemføres i samarbejde med eksterne leverandører og specialister.

Brug din projektledererfaring til at skabe resultater

Som person er du struktureret, selvstændig og god til at skabe relationer på tværs af organisationer og fagligheder. Du trives med at samle mange interessenter omkring fælles mål og evner at skabe fremdrift i komplekse projekter med mange afhængigheder.
Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med projektledelse og gerne fra områder som fysisk sikkerhed, kritisk infrastruktur, forsvar, beredskab eller andre sikkerhedskritiske miljøer.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du kommer med følgende:

Erfaring med projektledelse i komplekse organisationer
Erfaring med fysisk sikkerhed, kritisk infrastruktur eller beslægtede områder
Stærke kompetencer inden for planlægning, koordinering og stakeholder management
Erfaring med at samarbejde med eksterne leverandører og samarbejdspartnere
Forståelse for risikostyring, compliance og myndighedskrav
Evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt og skabe struktur i mange parallelle projekter
Gode kommunikative evner og erfaring med at samarbejde på tværs af organisatoriske niveauer.

Da du skal arbejde med kritisk infrastruktur, er det en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele ansættelsen.

Få indflydelse på den fysiske sikkerhed i Norlys

Skulle du have spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Thomas Lager, Manager i Physical Security, på telefon 2827 0321.

Diversitet og inklusion er en del af Norlys’ DNA og vores værdier: fællesskab, nytænkning og ansvarlighed. Vi mener, at et ægte fællesskab er rummeligt, trygt og inspirerende, at det er ansvarligt at skabe plads til forskellighed, og at vi bedst kan tænke nyt, når vi bringer alle kompetencer i spil. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset baggrund til at søge jobbet.

Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og tager jobannoncen ned, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send os dit CV (og eventuelt ansøgning) hurtigst muligt.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Prendere in carico la commessa, verificando contratto, specifiche tecniche, scopo di fornitura, milestone e condizioni di consegna.

Laurea in Ingegneria Gestionale o similare.

Padronanza di Excel, ERP e strumenti di pianificazione progetti.

Smart working.
Un ambiente dinamico, dove l’esperienza viene valorizzata e condivisa.

new_jobs.title: People Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Enfuce:

Founded in 2016, Enfuce is a female-founded and led global payments partner solving payments complexity for ambitious brands, banks and fintech leaders. Born in the Nordics and built for the world, Enfuce combines deep payments expertise with cloud-native technology to help customers launch and scale with confidence.
Enfuce is a strategic issuing and licensing partner delivering premium, flexible payment programmes across consumer, commercial and B2B use cases. Built for fast launch and trusted scale, Enfuce designs, launches and runs card programmes supporting debit, credit, prepaid, fleet and fuel propositions, alongside digital wallets and card scheme connectivity.
Enfuce combines cloud-native issuing, embedded compliance and fraud intelligence to deliver velocity with control. Its modular technology and in-house expertise enable customers to create tailored payment solutions that are flexible, scalable and secure.
As a regulated payments partner, Enfuce holds Electronic Money Institution licences from both the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority and the UK Financial Conduct Authority and is a principal member of Visa and Mastercard. Its PCI-DSS-certified, cloud-native platform is designed for enterprise-grade reliability and global scalability, with 99.999% platform uptime.
Enfuce has raised €73.5 million in funding and has received industry recognition including Fintech of the Year and Best ESG Campaign at the 2024 European Fintech Awards.

About The Role:

At Enfuce, we're on a mission to reshape the future of payments. We're building the most sustainable and scalable issuer processing platform in Europe, and our people are the foundation of that.
This role sits in our People Team and reports to our Chief People Officer. We build our people experience the same way you'd build a product. We look at what people actually need, we build it, we measure it and we improve it. To do that well we need good data, and right now ours needs work. That's where you come in.
You'll take our people data from where it is today to something we can genuinely rely on: clean, structured, and connected properly into Enfuce's central data platform. From there you'll turn it into the insights that shape what we build next, and the evidence that tells us whether it worked.
The role will evolve over time. To begin with it's roughly 90% foundation work, getting our data into shape. Once that's solid, more of your time will go into feeding real data into the agents and AI-powered people products we're building. It's a data role the whole way through, the focus just shifts as we go.
You won't be doing this on your own. You'll work day to day with the People Team, and you'll be connected to our central Data & AI team for platform, standards and your own development. You'll also work closely with our People Product Lead, who builds our People Products and AI automations and will rely on your data to do it.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build a data foundation we can trust. Get our people data clean and reliable, own the quality across our systems, and move our reporting to ThoughtSpot together with the central Data & AI team. Very few People teams have ever done this properly.
Turn data into direction. Dig into where we lose time, what causes friction, and what really drives engagement and retention. Bring us ideas that come out of what you've found, and give our leaders something they can act on.
Connect people's data to the business. Linked up with Finance it makes headcount planning and forecasting much sharper. Built into our leading and lagging indicators, it shows how our people connect to what the business is trying to achieve.
Prove what we build works. Set the success measures before we build something, then go back afterwards and check whether it was delivered. We'd rather find out quickly and change course than be right slowly.
Power the AI builds. Work with the People Product Lead on agents, automations and AI-powered people products. You'll build the data layer they run on and measure what they're worth. This part of the role grows as we go.

What You'll Bring:

3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, taking messy raw data through to a clear insight and a recommendation. Experience embedded in a business function is even better.
Strong SQL skills and experience with modern cloud data platforms, such as Snowflake (preferred), BigQuery, or Databricks. You're comfortable working with large datasets and understanding how data moves from source systems into analytical models.
Hands-on experience with dbt or similar analytics engineering practices. You know how to build maintainable transformation pipelines, structure models, test and document data, and manage dependencies between datasets.
Comfort with Git-based development workflows. Version control, branches, pull or merge requests, code review, and collaborative development are a normal part of how you work.
Strong experience with modern BI and analytics platforms, such as ThoughtSpot (preferred), Looker, or Omni. You've built dashboards and analytical experiences that people genuinely use, and you understand how the BI layer connects to the underlying data models and sources.
Experience working with sensitive data and analytics access controls. You understand concepts such as role-based access, row-level security, column-level security, data masking, and least-privilege access, and can apply them pragmatically when working with sensitive People data.

Why You’ll Love Working At Enfuce:

High autonomy & ownership: We give you the freedom to own your work and trust you to make the best decisions for your projects.
Top-tier talent: Join a team of industry experts and highly skilled professionals who are as passionate as you are about innovation.
Unlimited growth potential: We support your ambition with plenty of room for personal and professional growth within the company.
Flexible, remote work: Work from anywhere up to 30 days, in an environment that values flexibility and work-life balance.
A supportive culture: You’ll be part of a team that encourages, motivates, and celebrates success together.

Comprehensive benefits package:
We take care of our people with great benefits to match the value you bring.

Benefits & Perks:

Fair pay and employee stock option:

We value the input of every employee and want you to tap into the growth we build together. That’s why our salaries are competitive and reassessed regularly, and you have access to an employee stock option program.

Flexible Paid Time Off:

We offer a flexible paid time off policy, providing up to 5 weeks of annual vacation days and paid family leave, subject to country regulations. Additionally, you can benefit from hybrid or remote work options, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

Regular Fun With Your Team:

To spend other than work-related time with your teammates, you get a team activity budget for three quarters a year. The fourth quarter is reserved for a company-wide event.

Healthcare, Mobile Phone And More:

Depending on location, additional benefits can include healthcare, pension, phone support, lunch, wellbeing and insurance benefits.

Hands-on remediation across Active Directory, Windows and Linux, network, cloud, endpoint and security tooling, removing attacker persistence and restoring trust
Driving patching and vulnerability remediation, prioritised by business risk and threat actor behaviour
Reviewing and redesigning network architecture and security controls, including segmentation, firewall rules and administrative access paths, to reduce the risk of reinfection
Building isolated recovery environments and secure rebuild strategies, including backup validation and restore sequencing
Defining phased recovery and security improvement roadmaps, from immediate stabilisation to long-term transformation
Managing delivery end to end: stakeholder communication, reporting, proposals and mentoring junior team members

Between incidents, you'll support clients with recovery readiness and resilience work, such as recovery playbooks, Active Directory resilience assessments and ransomware recovery planning. You'll also help build the team's own capability: playbooks, tooling, automation, lab environments and training.

What you'll bring

Eligibility for SC clearance (existing SC or DV is beneficial)
Significant, proven cyber security incident experience, including supporting recovery from ransomware, Active Directory compromise, network intrusion or large-scale infrastructure incidents
Strong hands-on infrastructure skills across Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, networking and cloud (Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365), able to work at sysadmin level during recovery
Experience leading remediation: identity and AD hardening, patching, secure rebuild, backup validation and restoring business-critical services
A solid grasp of network architecture and security, including segmentation and firewall design
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to brief both technical teams and executives under pressure
Project and delivery management skills, including managing multiple workstreams and cases at once
Willingness to take part in the on-call rota and travel at short notice

Why join

Work on nationally significant incidents for a Tier 1 provider, with exposure across government and critical infrastructure
Shape a rapidly growing recovery capability rather than join a settled one
Investment in certifications, training and technical growth
A clear route into senior cyber response and recovery leadership

Location and working pattern

Hybrid, with about 60% of the week with clients or in the office and 40% elsewhere, including home. You must live within commuting distance of Canary Wharf, London or St Peter's Square, Manchester.

new_jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.  
Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on? Global Brand and Creative defines, expresses, and amplifies the Roku brand—setting the strategy and elevating our story with high-quality creative, brand consistency and efficiency across the entire Roku portfolio. Within Global Brand team, the Creative Studio partners across devices, product, marketing, and advertising to deliver integrated marketing campaigns and promotions that drive awareness, engagement, and brand affinity for Roku and its sub-brands.

What is the role? We are looking for a Creative Project Manager to join the Global Brand and Creative Studio team, with dedicated support for the Roku Advertising organization. In this role, you will manage the day-to-day execution of creative projects across design, video, animation, motion graphics, events, executive presentations, and sales materials. You will use AI tools, workflows, and forward-thinking AI initiatives to support team creativity, capabilities, and efficiency, while helping make sure everything produced meets our high bar for design and brand alignment. You will partner closely with creative teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate requests into clear scopes, timelines, workflows, and deliverables. This is an individual contributor role that reports to the Manager of Creative Project Management and operates as part of the broader project management team. The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, solutions-oriented, and has an eye for design. Our industry changes quickly, so you will be comfortable responding to changing business needs, working through ambiguity, and helping teams stay aligned and moving forward. 
For New York Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $120,000 and 135,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off. 

  How will I use AI at Roku? At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.
We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.
  What are the responsibilities of the role? Manage revenue-supporting creative projects end-to-end, from intake and kickoff through reviews, approvals, delivery, and launch, including hour tracking and running meetings as needed
Build and maintain project timelines, workback schedules, and milestone plans for sales materials, presentations, sizzle reels, and other revenue-driving initiatives
Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify scope, gather inputs, and align on priorities, deliverables, reviews, and approvals
Balance and prioritize planned work with fast-moving business opportunities while communicating clearly about timing, scope, and tradeoffs
Provide the creative team with the assets, feedback, and decisions they need to move forward, whether working with internal team members, freelancers, contractors, agencies, production companies, or post-production partners
Manage internal and external resourcing with the goal of streamlining costs and resources
Maintain organized records of project costs, approvals, and external partner commitments
Help coordinate high-visibility Roku Advertising moments, including NewFronts, Cannes Lions, Advertising Week, CES, executive presentations, and partner events
Use AI tools to streamline work, including status tracking and updates, meeting summaries, daily workflows, and reporting that tracks efficiencies and surfaces risks
Leverage AI to create cost savings and efficiencies that positively impact Roku's bottom line
Uphold a high standard for design quality and brand alignment across all creative deliverables

  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? 5+ years of experience in project management, creative operations, integrated production, or related roles, with meaningful experience in integrated marketing, AI, or creative development
Experience supporting an in-house creative team, advertising organization, agency, media company, entertainment company, or technology brand
Strong understanding of creative development, production workflows, reviews, approvals, and final asset delivery
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholder workflows, deadlines, and changing priorities simultaneously in an environment where business needs can shift quickly
Collaborative, detail-oriented, and highly organized, with the ability to work across multiple time zones
Experience working with project management, review, collaboration, and asset management platforms
Hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline project management and improve efficiency, with curiosity about emerging tools and a forward-thinking approach to how teams work with AI productivity tools
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate status, timelines, risks, and next steps to both stakeholders and creatives
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline preferred, but not required

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations
Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?
Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 
We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

Turing is looking for candidates with strong experience in project planning, execution, and stakeholder coordination, particularly at the level expected for professional project managers leading cross-functional teams and complex technical or scientific initiatives.

Role overview:

In this role, you will contribute to projects that help evaluate and enhance AI systems using your project management and organizational expertise.
No prior AI experience is required.
These projects will help you explore how AI can improve workflow planning, communication, and process automation across professional and technical environments.

Design and solve real-world project management and coordination scenarios to test AI reasoning.
Write clear, structured explanations covering project scheduling, risk assessment, resource allocation, and performance tracking.
Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with industry project management frameworks.
Collaborate with researchers to refine AI understanding of PMI’s PMBOK, Agile, and Scrum methodologies.

4+ years of experience as a Project Manager, Program Coordinator, or Project Management Specialist.
Background in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Strong familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, MS Project) and frameworks (Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall).
Excellent English communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain structured processes clearly.

Strong compensation (exact amount varies by project).
Fully remote work environment.

Confidential or proprietary information from any employer, university, etc.

Specific client information or case details.
Any information that would violate NDAs, employment agreements or other confidentiality obligations.

Job details:
Lead a high-impact Billing & Revenue Management transformation for a sophisticated, growing wealth management organization — a long-term consulting engagement where your expertise will directly shape the future operating model, strategy, and execution.

This Jobot Consulting Job is hosted by: Mark C. Johnson
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
and sending us your resume.
Salary: $100 - $150 per hour

A bit about us:

Our client is a leading national wealth management organization serving high-net-worth individuals, families, business owners, executives, and institutions. The firm provides sophisticated investment management, financial planning, tax, estate planning, and other wealth management services to clients across the country.

With a strong platform, continued growth, and an increasingly sophisticated operating environment, the organization is investing in the processes, technology, infrastructure, and operating models necessary to support its next stage of growth.

This is an opportunity to join that transformation at an important point in the organization's evolution.

Why join us?

This is not a traditional Project Manager role.

You won't simply be responsible for maintaining project plans, coordinating meetings, tracking timelines, and managing deliverables. You will have real ownership over the assessment and transformation of a critical business function.

You will evaluate the current Billing & Revenue Management environment, identify gaps and opportunities, define the future-state operating model, develop the transformation roadmap, and then help drive that roadmap through execution.

You'll work closely with senior leaders across Billing, Wealth Management, Innovation, Technology, Finance, and other key functions, providing broad exposure to a significant organizational transformation and the opportunity to influence decisions at the leadership level.

This is an ideal engagement for a consultant who enjoys solving complex business problems, getting into the details, developing practical solutions, influencing stakeholders, and then staying close to the work to ensure those solutions are successfully implemented.

What Makes This Engagement Compelling?
High-impact work: Your recommendations and execution will directly influence how a critical business function operates and scales.
End-to-end ownership: Take the organization from current-state assessment through target operating model, transformation roadmap, and implementation.
Executive exposure: Partner with senior leaders across multiple functions and help drive alignment and decision-making.
Strategic + hands-on: Combine operational analysis, strategy, business case development, process improvement, and execution.
Long-term engagement: Make a lasting impact through a transformation initiative that extends well beyond a short-term project.
Sophisticated environment: Work at the intersection of wealth management, billing, revenue, technology, data, controls, and operating processes.
Build for scale: Help establish processes, governance, KPIs, controls, reporting, and capabilities designed to support continued growth.

Job Details

We are seeking a highly experienced Project Manager / Business Transformation Consultant to lead the assessment and transformation of Billing & Revenue Management.

The consultant will establish a fact-based understanding of the current state, identify gaps and opportunities, define a Billing-specific target operating model, develop the transformation roadmap, and drive execution through implementation.

This is a highly visible, hands-on consulting engagement requiring someone who can operate independently, move with urgency, develop rigorous analysis and recommendations, and maintain momentum with limited oversight.

The successful individual will be comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous or complex situations, anticipating what needs to happen next, engaging senior stakeholders, challenging constructively, and driving accountability through execution.

Key Responsibilities
Lead a structured, end-to-end assessment of the current Billing & Revenue Management operating model, identifying gaps, risks, capabilities, inefficiencies, and opportunities for scale.
Analyze current processes, workflows, systems, data, controls, governance, organizational capabilities, and performance metrics.
Develop rigorous, executive-ready deliverables, including:
Current-state and future-state process documentation
End-to-end workflow analysis
Quantitative and gap analysis
Business requirements
Business cases
Vendor evaluations
Executive recommendations
Define the Billing target operating model, establishing future-state capabilities across people, process, technology, data, controls, governance, and performance.
Develop and prioritize a comprehensive transformation roadmap aligned with broader Wealth Management transformation initiatives.
Build and implement scalable operating capabilities, including standardized processes and procedures, controls, service levels, KPIs, metrics, reporting, and training.
Establish effective project governance, including project plans, milestones, decision forums, dependencies, risks, issues, accountability, and measures of success.
Represent Billing & Revenue Management in broader transformation initiatives and cross-functional programs.
Partner closely with Innovation, Technology, Finance, Wealth Management, and other senior stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable solutions.
Lead discussions, present recommendations, challenge constructively, facilitate alignment, and drive decisions.
Independently advance the transformation roadmap, maintaining accountability and momentum through execution.
Proactively identify barriers, resolve issues, and escalate decisions or support when necessary.
Maintain senior leadership visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and outcomes.

Qualifications
7+ years of project management and/or business transformation experience, with a demonstrated track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from assessment and strategy through implementation.
Experience within Wealth Management, RIA, or a closely related financial services environment is required.
Experience with advisory fee billing and/or revenue management is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience conducting end-to-end operational assessments and translating findings into target operating models, transformation roadmaps, and successful implementations.
Strong quantitative, analytical, process improvement, and root-cause analysis skills.
Ability to personally develop business cases, recommendations, presentations, and executive-ready deliverables.
Proven ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment with limited oversight.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to drive accountability, decisions, and execution across teams that may not report directly to you.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
PMP certification strongly preferred.
Lean Six Sigma or comparable process improvement certification is a plus.

The Ideal Consultant:
The ideal consultant is someone who can zoom out to see the strategic picture and zoom in to understand how the work actually gets done.

You are comfortable entering an environment where not everything is already defined, asking the right questions, analyzing the facts, developing a point of view, and taking ownership of moving the organization forward.

You don't wait to be told what to do next. You anticipate it.

You can speak comfortably with operational teams about workflows and processes while also presenting a recommendation, business case, or transformation roadmap to senior leadership.

You are analytical without getting lost in the analysis. You are strategic without losing sight of execution. And you're comfortable challenging existing processes when the facts indicate there is a better way.

Most importantly, you enjoy transformation work where the expectation isn't simply to recommend change — it's to help make the change happen.

This is an opportunity to:
Lead a highly visible transformation. Build the future-state operating model. Partner with senior leadership. And leave a lasting impact on a critical function within a sophisticated, growing wealth management organization.

If you're an experienced Wealth Management transformation professional who thrives on complex problems, high visibility, and meaningful ownership, we'd like to hear from you.

About The Team

The Product Operations team works at the intersection of product, engineering, and platform to help teams deliver with purpose, speed, and measurable impact. This is an opportunity to shape how complex technical programs operate at scale across a collaborative, outcome-focused environment.

Position Summary

At PointClickCare, Technical Program Managers are strategic enablers of product outcomes, connecting strategy, delivery, and learning across our product and engineering ecosystem. You’ll orchestrate complex initiatives that span products, platforms, and domains, ensuring empowered teams have the clarity, alignment, and flow to deliver meaningful customer and business impact.

You bring clarity to complexity, align teams around shared outcomes, and accelerate delivery with purpose and precision.

You are part of PointClickCare’s evolution toward an empowered, product-led organization, where outcomes define success and flow defines health. You’ll operate at the intersection of product, engineering, and platform - driving systems that enable every team to deliver with purpose, speed, and measurable impact.

Enable product outcomes: Partner with Product and Engineering Leads to translate strategy and OKRs into coordinated execution plans, ensuring teams stay focused on delivering measurable customer and business value.

Drive clarity and flow: Remove ambiguity by connecting business intent to execution signals. Use delivery and outcome metrics to inform, not control, decision-making.
Harness AI for insight: Use AI-driven analytics to surface risks, detect bottlenecks, and generate proactive recommendations that improve velocity and predictability.
Champion empowered delivery: Coach teams on healthy operating rhythms and data-driven practices that balance autonomy with alignment.
Bridge strategy to execution: Facilitate alignment between senior product, design, and engineering leaders - making trade-offs visible, decisions explicit, and accountability shared.
Shape systems and culture: Contribute to how PointClickCare executes at scale, evolving shared tools, processes, and frameworks that amplify impact across the portfolio.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience leading complex software programs in TPM/EPM or similar roles.
3+ years driving multi-team initiatives across product and platform or infrastructure.
Experience translating strategy and OKRs into execution plans, managing dependencies, risks, and delivery health signals.
Proficient with program execution and delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, Aha! or equivalents) for planning, dependency management, status reporting, and stakeholder visibility.
Technical fluency in modern software systems (APIs, architectures, integration patterns) and ability to engage in technical design conversations.
Experience using metrics to improve predictability, flow, and outcomes; comfort using AI tools to support analysis and decision-making.
Proven track record delivering complex programs (SaaS, large systems) that span multiple teams and domains (platform, product, data).
Technical fluency - you understand system architectures, APIs, integration patterns, and can engage in technical design conversations.
Systems-level thinking - you see cross-cutting dependencies and can reason about how one program impacts others.
Influence without authority - you align stakeholders, manage conflict, and build consensus across teams with different priorities.
Data-driven mindset - you define and use meaningful metrics to track health, predict issues, and drive decisions.
Bias toward action & ownership - when ambiguity hits, you drive clarity and momentum.
AI fluency and curiosity:
Understanding of applied AI concepts
Comfort using AI tools to support analysis, documentation, and decision-making.
Awareness of responsible and ethical AI practices in engineering environments.

Excellent communication skills - able to tailor messages and status to technical teams, product partners, and senior leadership.
Passion for using technology, including AI, to improve how teams work, decide, and deliver.
You connect dots across the portfolio to drive outcome alignment and accelerate flow.
You coach teams to operate with greater autonomy, velocity, and data-driven decision-making.
You embody AI-first leadership, role-modeling intelligent ways of working that elevate how the organization learns and executes.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The importance of water to the health of our world can’t be overstated.

As the frequency and intensity of floods, droughts and storms increases, the water industry must continue to build resiliency and lead from the front.

Together with our clients, we are thinking and doing things differently to help pre-empt and prepare for what's next. Be a part of this dynamic and committed team of diverse water specialists and drive change for your community.

You’ll be able to apply our powerful global network of skills and decades of experience to create positive water outcomes that respect nature and nurture communities.

Who are we looking for?

In response to continued growth within our US East Water & Wastewater Treatment business, our team in Bowie, MD
is seeking an experienced Project Manager
to help drive the development and expansion of our Water Business across the metro Washington, D.C. area. In this role, you’ll provide technical leadership and oversee the delivery of water and wastewater treatment and infrastructure projects for our valued clients. You’ll lead project teams, manage budgets and schedules, and serve as the project’s primary client contact; ensuring excellence in every phase of project execution.

Beyond project delivery, you’ll play an important role in business development, marketing strategies, and client engagement; with opportunities to shape win strategies and pricing for new work. This position also offers the chance to mentor project team members and collaborate with project team leaders across the region. If you’re passionate about innovative water solutions, thrive in a leadership role, and want to make an impact on critical infrastructure projects, we’d love to have you on our team!

Our Hybrid Work Model:

Be part of the dynamic culture! Our workplace thrives on a hybrid model, combining in-office collaboration and flexibility. Join us in the office three days a week to contribute, connect and excel in our vibrant environment.

Working with an energetic and high performing team, this position offers a variety of work and will see you involved in:

Client & Customer Management (External): Manage relationships with small clients while also helping senior colleagues manage relationships with larger key clients and customers.
Community of Practice Management: Participate actively in a community of practice in a defined area of expertise or consulting to build own expertise.
Contract Management: Deliver required outcomes by managing day-to-day relationships with contract service providers while working within an established contract management plan.
Engineering Solutions Design: Design engineering solutions and the associated validation process to enable the realization of a design brief (for example, in terms of functionality, performance, aesthetics, and cost) that conform to organizational and/or regulatory standards.
Feasibility Studies: Conduct complex feasibility studies from a technological and organizational perspective and document findings to complete cost-benefit analysis on implementing changes to business processes, products, or business unit structure.
Health, Safety, and Environment: Follow the organization's health, safety, and environment (HSE) policies, procedures, and mandatory instructions to identify and mitigate environmental risks and risks to the well-being of self and others in the workplace. Identify patterns of risky behavior within the team and take appropriate action to resolve them, escalating serious issues as appropriate.
Improvement/Innovation: Identify shortcomings in existing processes, systems, and procedures, and use established change management programs to address them.
Personal Capability Building: Develop own capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching; gain or maintain external professional accreditation, where relevant, to improve performance and fulfill personal potential. Maintain an in-depth understanding of technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.
Project Management: Deliver small- or medium-scale projects while working within an established program management plan.
Request for Bid Solicitation/Proposal/Tender Response: Gather information and resources, draft and complete proposals, and fulfill all process requirements (in terms of deadlines, documentation, etc.) in response to bid solicitations, request for proposal, and request for tender to create the best chance of being awarded the contract.
Technical Developments Recommendation: Discuss and recommend more complex or innovative technical developments to improve the quality of the used technology, such as systems, processes, infrastructure, installations, and machines.

What you’ll bring to the team:

Bachelor's and/or Master’s degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a related field of study with a water/wastewater focus
Professional Engineering license (Maryland or Virginia preferred)
Minimum of 10 years of experience in the planning, design and construction of water/wastewater infrastructure and treatment facilities (some time spent serving clients in the metro-Washington D.C. and surrounding area preferred)
Experience with business development, proposal preparation, and marketing skills preferred
A standout colleague and project leader with a strong client focus
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary technical staff
Practiced self-management skills related to organization, budget control, and schedule management

Benefits:

401K - Employees are eligible to participate on the first day of the month following 3 months of service
Paid time off – Our PTO benefit is designed to provide eligible employees with a period of rest and relaxation, sick, and personal time throughout the year. PTO starts at 16 days per year and increases with years of service
Holiday Pay - Holiday pay is provided for eligible employees. GHD observes 9 holidays per year. Holiday pay will be based on the regular set schedule for the employee
Wellness Benefit- Regular full-term employees are eligible to participate in the wellness reimbursement program. GHD will reimburse 50% of the cost of the following to maximum of $250.00 reimbursement annually for such items as: Health club membership fees, home exercise equipment purchases, Bicycles, Race, run & marathon entrance fees, Smoking cessation programs, Weight loss programs (i.e.—Weight Watchers, Jenny Craig), Fitbits and Fitness Tracking devices

Salary range:
$112,800-$188,000 based on experience and location

As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of a diverse workforce. GHD is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, genetic information, national origin, sex (including same sex), sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, age, disability or handicap, citizenship status, service member status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

About Us

Take on some of the world’s toughest challenges - with GHD supporting you every step of the way.

We'll give you control over your career, empower you to find innovative solutions and help you create a lasting impact.

See where your commitment could take you with GHD.

Our Pledge to You

At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day.

That’s why we pledge to empower our people to make a positive impact. Combining our deep technical expertise with the capabilities of our clients and partners, we respond to some of the most complex challenges facing our planet today.

See where your commitment could take you.

That’s the #PowerOfCommitment

Who We Are

GHD is a global professional services company that leads through engineering, architecture, and construction expertise. We are an employee-owned company with over 11,000 diverse and skilled individuals, across more than 200 offices spanning five continents.

The Power of Commitment is our brand promise. It’s what makes us different. We are bound to our stated vision and determination to address humanity’s most urgent needs: to make water, energy and urbanisation sustainable for generations to come.

:

TS/SCI, must be able to obtain TS/SCI with poly

:

Must have extensive knowledge of the DD Form 254 and how it is incorporated in the Air Force acquisition process

401K with company match

Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career
Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications
Cutting-edge technology you can learn from

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst, Studios
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Senior Business Analyst will establish and maintain a programme-level, source-traceable baseline by consolidating information from email, Teams and meeting records, Jira/Confluence, action and decision logs, design submissions, workshops and third-party inputs. The role will connect business needs to technical, property, operational and delivery workstreams, translate complexity into decision-ready outputs, and provide constructive challenge without replacing the responsibilities of technical SMEs, architects or delivery owners.

Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities

Lead discovery workshops and stakeholder discussions with TKO, IMG and relevant third parties.
Elicit, document, validate and prioritise business requirements across Broadcast and Corporate.
Map current- and future-state processes, user journeys, interfaces and operational hand-offs.
Consolidate inputs from networking, cloud, Corporate IT/AV, Broadcast IT and Security into a coherent programme view.
Identify gaps, overlaps, assumptions, dependencies, risks, ownership issues and unresolved decisions.
Maintain traceability from business needs through to technical requirements, design inputs, decisions and delivery actions.
Support the Broadcast interface with dB Broadcast and the Corporate interface.
Map dependencies and hand-offs across TKO, IMG, G&T, MiX, Perkins & Will, Hoare Lea and other project contributors.
Provide analysis to inform scope, RACI, RAID, action logs, decision logs, change control and operational readiness.
Produce concise updates highlighting progress, gaps, decisions required and next actions.
Maintain a single, programme-level and source-traceable baseline across workstreams, drawing together email, Teams and meeting records, Jira/Confluence, design documents, action logs, decision logs and third-party inputs.
Coordinate inputs and follow-up from the regular Project IT/AV/Security forum, including MiX and relevant TKO, IMG, property, engineering and specialist supplier representatives.
Translate technical and design outputs into clear business requirements, interface definitions, acceptance criteria, ownership questions, operational impacts and decision papers.
Support definition of operational ownership, monitoring responsibilities, escalation routes, support processes, service levels and handover evidence for building and technology services.
Support scope, budget, lead-time and delivery-impact analysis where technical, property or operational decisions affect programme sequencing and readiness.

Knowledge And Experience

Senior-level experience as a Business Analyst on complex transformation, infrastructure, new-build, relocation, workplace or property programmes.
Strong requirements elicitation, process mapping, user-journey, documentation and traceability skills.
Experience working across business, technology, programme and third-party delivery teams.
Ability to create structure where information, ownership and requirements are distributed across multiple teams.
Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
Experience working with technical SMEs across areas such as networking, cloud, AV, security or broadcast technology.
Understanding of live and non-live media workflows, or the ability to develop this quickly.
Experience supporting operational readiness, transition, service ownership or handover activity.
Comfortable working with ambiguity while maintaining clear, accurate and actionable outputs.
Familiarity with process modelling, requirements management and collaboration tools.
Ability to work across technical and non-technical domains and understand enough of network, cloud, security, broadcast, workplace and building-services interfaces to ask the right questions.
Ability to distinguish confirmed facts, working assumptions, decisions, risks, issues, dependencies and recommendations, and to challenge constructively when evidence or ownership is unclear.
Experience working within multi-party delivery and design-assurance models involving internal teams, consultants, integrators, suppliers and client-side stakeholders.
Strong analytical writing and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into concise outputs for senior stakeholders and delivery teams.

Approach

Applies a robust and systematic approach to discovery, analysis, documentation and validation.
Integrates effectively with the wider Project Programme Team.
Collaborates across TKO, IMG, Broadcast, Corporate and third-party workstreams.
Reports transparently on progress, risks, dependencies, gaps and decisions required.
Creates clarity without taking ownership of technical architecture or design decisions.
Balances sufficient detail for traceability with concise outputs that support decision-making.
Operates at programme level, connecting workstreams rather than optimising a single technical domain in isolation.
Uses evidence and validation: clearly records what is confirmed, what is assumed, what has been decided and what remains open.
Treats the baseline as a living source of truth, updating it as new information is received and preserving source and version traceability.
Brings ownership and decision gaps to the right people early, follows through on actions and escalates where unresolved issues threaten scope, cost, schedule or readiness.
Balances enough technical detail for traceability with clear business language, practical judgement and concise decision support.
Knowledge of cloud media workflows, content-production environments or enterprise technology integrations.
Familiarity with Corporate IT/AV, Broadcast IT, networking, security and building-services interfaces.
Experience working in both Agile and Waterfall programmes, including RACI, RAID and governance activity.
Experience on a complex new-build, relocation, campus consolidation or technology-enabled workplace programme.

Aptitudes

Ownership, accountability and delivery focus
Structured analysis, requirements and process expertise
Stakeholder engagement, facilitation, collaboration and influencing
Constructive challenge, problem-solving and pragmatic judgement
Programme integration and cross-domain thinking
Risk, dependency, issue and interface management
Ability to manage ambiguity and complexity
Clear, concise written and verbal communication

Success Measures

A consolidated, validated and traceable Project baseline is established.
Broadcast and Corporate requirements, processes, journeys and shared dependencies are clearly understood.
TKO’s distributed technical input is brought together into a coherent programme-level view.
Interfaces, hand-offs, ownership gaps, assumptions and unresolved decisions are visible and assigned or escalated.
Requirements can be traced through to scope, design, decisions, risks, actions and operational-readiness activity.
The Corporate interface into Project is sufficiently formalised to support planning and delivery.
The resulting baseline can be maintained by the Project team after the initial BA engagement.

In addition, success at IMG is driven by four core competencies
that apply to all employees:

Business Acumen
– Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes

Operational Excellence
– Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations

Innovation Mindset
– Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development

Leadership & Collaboration
– Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

Working Conditions

This is a 2 year fixed-term contract position
Working hours are 9:00 – 17:00, Monday to Friday
This will be based at the IMG Offices in Stockley Park, Uxbridge with travel to other IMG offices and/or buildings as required.
Adapting to use of new systems and technology where appropriate

TKO EEO Statement

TKO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding non-discrimination in employment. TKO makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications, without considering an employee’s or applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under federal, state or local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the Company has facilities. TKO also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state or local laws. For information about Privacy and Information Security for TKO employment candidates, please review our Privacy Policy. For information regarding Terms of Use for this and other TKO websites, please review our Terms of Use.

new_jobs.title: Cyber Security Manager - Response and Recovery
new_jobs.description:
Cyber Security Manager - DFIR (SC)

Lead the recovery when a client's worst day hits: rebuild, remediate and restore after ransomware and major cyber incidents, with one of the UK's Tier 1 incident response teams.

Location:
London (Canary Wharf) or Manchester, hybrid
Salary:
£75,000 – £85,000
Grade:
Manager, Cyber Advisory (Technology & Digital)
Clearance:
current SC or DV, or eligibility and willingness to obtain SC
Travel and on-call:
on-call rotation; short-notice travel for up to 2–3 weeks at a time

About the opportunity

Our client is one of only nine Tier 1 incident response providers in the UK, and its Cyber Response Services team is growing, with six new hires planned across grades. This Manager role focuses on what happens after an incident is contained: getting the business running again, safely, and making sure the attacker can't come back.

Clients turn to the team for ransomware, destructive malware, business email compromise, Active Directory compromise, cloud compromise and advanced network intrusions. You will turn incident findings into practical remediation, rebuild and recovery plans. You'll work alongside incident response leads, forensic teams, legal advisers, insurers and client executives. This is a hands-on recovery role, not a pure incident response one.

What you'll be doing

Leading recovery workstreams during major incidents and post-incident remediation programmes
Hands-on remediation across Active Directory, Windows and Linux, network, cloud, endpoint and security tooling, removing attacker persistence and restoring trust
Driving patching and vulnerability remediation, prioritised by business risk and threat actor behaviour
Reviewing and redesigning network architecture and security controls, including segmentation, firewall rules and administrative access paths, to reduce the risk of reinfection
Building isolated recovery environments and secure rebuild strategies, including backup validation and restore sequencing
Defining phased recovery and security improvement roadmaps, from immediate stabilisation to long-term transformation
Managing delivery end to end: stakeholder communication, reporting, proposals and mentoring junior team members

Between incidents, you'll support clients with recovery readiness and resilience work, such as recovery playbooks, Active Directory resilience assessments and ransomware recovery planning. You'll also help build the team's own capability: playbooks, tooling, automation, lab environments and training.

What you'll bring

Eligibility for SC clearance (existing SC or DV is beneficial)
Significant, proven cyber security incident experience, including supporting recovery from ransomware, Active Directory compromise, network intrusion or large-scale infrastructure incidents
Strong hands-on infrastructure skills across Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, networking and cloud (Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365), able to work at sysadmin level during recovery
Experience leading remediation: identity and AD hardening, patching, secure rebuild, backup validation and restoring business-critical services
A solid grasp of network architecture and security, including segmentation and firewall design
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to brief both technical teams and executives under pressure
Project and delivery management skills, including managing multiple workstreams and cases at once
Willingness to take part in the on-call rota and travel at short notice

Why join

Work on nationally significant incidents for a Tier 1 provider, with exposure across government and critical infrastructure
Shape a rapidly growing recovery capability rather than join a settled one
Investment in certifications, training and technical growth
A clear route into senior cyber response and recovery leadership

Location and working pattern

Hybrid, with about 60% of the week with clients or in the office and 40% elsewhere, including home. You must live within commuting distance of Canary Wharf, London or St Peter's Square, Manchester.

Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We spun out of Peppy Health to take on what we believe is the biggest untouched opportunity in enterprise software.
Global employers spend $3–5 trillion on benefits every year. It is their second-largest cost after payroll, yet the category still runs on legacy systems and spreadsheets. Incumbents cannot move fast enough, and AI-first startups have mostly overlooked it.

We have two products:
GAP (Global Administration Platform)
for global benefits teams. It uses LLMs to parse and extract policy documents into a structured ontology, and gives admins spend and utilisation tools across every country they operate in.
Navigator
, the employee-facing product that helps people understand and use their benefits.

We are post product-market fit at seed stage, live with some of the world's largest household-name enterprises, and we land and expand country by country. Our big current focus is flexible benefits and open enrollment. We stay deliberately lean so that the people who join own a meaningful piece of what we build.
This is also genuine tech for good: better benefits administration directly improves the wellbeing and financial security of millions of employees.

The Role

As a Senior
Deployment Strategist
you will spend roughly 80% of your time on client work and 20% on developing our products. You will own a portfolio of approximately 1 to 3 enterprise accounts, depending on size, from post-sale through live launch and beyond.
This is not a project management role. With the Euphoric MCP you will build custom agents, automations and workflows for some of the world's largest employers. You will be on the edge of AI in the workplace, guiding how global enterprises roll AI out to their benefits teams and employees.

Deployment Strategist
, but you can expect to:

Design and ship custom agents, automations and workflows that solve each client's specific problems, from reporting and renewals to employee communications.
Run the relationship.

Shape the product (~20%).

Step into product when it's quieter.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

In the role of Program Manager, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary infrastructure programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of infrastructure programs, which are all critical to program success. Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client's specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution. This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, construction management, cost control/estimating, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making. Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff. Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communications. Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance. Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program's financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR's program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.
Perform other duties as needed

Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Professional Engineering License
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one [transportation/water/resources] infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff
Willingness to travel and, if needed, commute to a client's site temporarily

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Planning, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Program management experience consistent with one of the following requirements:
A minimum of three (3) years of program management experience in a deputy role to the Program Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, with a cumulative capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of five (5) years of program management experience as a Project Manager or Project Controls Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, each with a capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of ten (10) years of project management experience as a Project Manager directing a multi-disciplinary team for the delivery of at least two (2) projects, each with a capital value of $50 million or more
Strong leadership skills with experience building a cohesive team culture and managing team members in various locations.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to client executives and in front of a large audience in a public setting
